name: chatprd
description: Write, review, and update product requirements documents with ChatPRD from ChatGPT, Codex, and Cursor. Draft PRDs from notes or code context with ChatPRD's templates (no account needed), critique specs, plan implementation from a PRD, and keep docs in sync with what shipped.

interface.longDescription: ChatPRD is the AI copilot for product managers. Draft PRDs, AI development briefs, user testing plans, and launch checklists from rough notes or code context using ChatPRD's built-in templates, with no account required: get the document as Markdown or save it to a connected tool like Notion or Google Drive. Review any PRD for gaps and unclear requirements. Connect a ChatPRD account to save documents to ChatPRD, use your own templates and projects, find your team's documents, and update specs as decisions change. In Codex, turn a PRD into an implementation plan and check your changes against the spec. Account features only access documents, projects, and templates available to your connected ChatPRD account.
defaultPrompt: Write a PRD for this feature idea using ChatPRD's template.
Review my latest ChatPRD document and point out gaps.
Find my ChatPRD docs about onboarding.

positive.description: Write a PRD without a ChatPRD account using the built-in ChatPRD PRD template
positive.prompt: Use ChatPRD's PRD template to write a PRD for adding saved searches to our job board.
positive.expected_behavior: Without asking the user to sign in, fetches the ChatPRD PRD template and returns a complete Markdown PRD for saved searches that follows the template's sections, with no leftover template instructions or placeholders.

positive.description: Browse ChatPRD's built-in templates without an account
positive.prompt: What document templates does ChatPRD have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists ChatPRD's built-in templates (PRD, Product Brief for AI Development, User Testing Plan, Product Launch Checklist) with what each is for, and offers to write one.

positive.description: Create a PRD from a short feature description using the user's templates and projects
positive.prompt: Write a PRD in ChatPRD for adding dark mode to our mobile app.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks which project to use (or skips if none), picks a PRD template, creates a new ChatPRD document with problem, goals, requirements, and open questions, and returns the document link.

positive.description: Search the user's documents by topic
positive.prompt: Find my ChatPRD documents about onboarding.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching documents from the connected account with titles and links, or says clearly that none were found.

positive.description: Review an existing PRD for gaps
positive.prompt: Review my most recent ChatPRD document and tell me what's missing.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches the latest document and returns a structured critique covering unclear goals, missing acceptance criteria, edge cases, and open questions, citing sections of the document. Does not modify the document.

positive.description: Update a document after the user confirms the change
positive.prompt: Add a success metrics section to my onboarding PRD in ChatPRD.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the onboarding PRD, proposes the new section, and after confirmation updates the document in ChatPRD and returns the link.

positive.prompt: What projects do I have in ChatPRD, and what documents are in the first one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's projects and the documents in the selected project without inventing any.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my ChatPRD documents.
Upgrade my ChatPRD subscription and charge my card.

negative.description: Unrelated request should not trigger ChatPRD tools
negative.prompt: What's the weather in San Francisco today?

review.commerce_description: ChatPRD does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Write PRDs, AI development briefs, user testing plans, and launch checklists with ChatPRD's built-in templates without a ChatPRD account. Connect an account to save to ChatPRD and use your own templates and projects.
